0d How specific you need to be

You don’t need to paste the full URL (though you can).

The agent can see your Drive folders through the connector — but only the folders/files your account has access to.

Best practice is to give:

Folder name (exact string if unique).

Optionally the folder ID (the long string in the Drive URL). That’s the most reliable.

Filters like “look for PDFs,” “look for files updated last wee"
